title: Avoid use of heading tags in dropdown menus
description:
https://github.com/posit-dev/shinymedia/blob/a075d5c9720e9a7ec8dfce4d4a0c498df49d3d29/python-package/shinymedia/ui.py#L96 I'm not sure why Bootstrap uses `
` in their dropdown menu examples, but in Quarto docs the heading element receives an anchor link. Also, while it doesn't cause any accessibility issues in this case, it's still a good idea not to jump between heading levels. ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d5b575ec-fb25-4e87-b449-7e4ffd42d27c) Something like this could work just as well: ```html
  • Dropdown header
    • ```

title: Feature request: audio input without video
description:
I'd like to be able to add an audio recording. Primary use case would be transcription or "chatting" with a chatbot.

I have a hacky version over in [here](https://github.com/MichelNivard/gptstudio/blob/audio-input/R/record-audio.R) based on the the video implementation from shinymedia.

I could contribute a PR if you're interested. I have a minimal version working in python, too.

title: Audio spinner first example in docs is not working
description:
The first audio spinner example is not working, neither for Python or R. https://posit-dev.github.io/shinymedia/#visualizing-audio-with-audio_spinner

The AudioContext was not allowed to start. It must be resumed (or created) after a user gesture on the page. https://goo.gl/7K7WLu

title: Replace demo MP3 file with a smaller example
description:
The current mp3 file is about 5MB, which means we couldn't include the file in an R package if we wanted to (we still might not want to).

I propose we replace the current example file with something smaller. Using Librivox, I found an interesting sample: https://archive.org/download/cbc039-magic_2406_librivox/cbc039_05_various_64kb.mp3 ([source collection](https://archive.org/details/cbc039-magic_2406_librivox/cbc039_05_various_128kb.mp3)) that's ~400KB.
